digest.component_or_area: LLM plan review gate — det_floor module split
propositions: det_floor.py exceeds the 800-line hard cap at 793 LOC and requires splitting along a documented seam
The four never-blocking advisory checks (P2, P3, P6, P7) form a closed call graph with zero inbound or outbound edges to the retained blocking checks and are candidates for extraction

The retained blocking checks (P1, P4, P5, P8, P10, P11) have interconnected dependencies (_count_ac_items, _clarity_score, est_tokens, det_lint graph helpers) and must remain in det_floor.py as the entry point

Module-object monkeypatching in test_plan_review.py, test_af77_config_fault.py, and test_plan_review_prerequisites.py targets DET_CHECKS, run_det_floor, and est_tokens — all in the retained half — so the split preserves existing test bindings

det_advisory.py must declare module-level imports (vague_hits_in_line, _lint_verify_command, _verify_command_strings) to satisfy p6_ac_quality's bare-name references, following the precedent of det_clarity.py and det_lint.py
det_floor.py remains the re-export gateway and dispatcher, keeping the invariant that all four moved checks remain accessible via their original import paths
